g.text: EOC (module board): U4A (hysteresis 75 mV / 0.29 V) -> 10 nF / 1M -> U4B against TREF: J12 EOC OUT, 0/+10 V for about 15 ms when the envelope reaches its floor; LED D63.

g.desc: EOC (module board): U4A (hysteresis 75 mV / 0.29 V) -> 10 nF / 1M -> U4B against TREF: J12 EOC OUT, 0/+10 V for about 15 ms when the envelope reaches its floor; LED D63.

g.text: Extras: J8 PUSH button (debounced by R17/C5, read by Q5 into Q1's base: a manual gate); J9 TRIG OUT (about 1.5 ms, 0/+10 V, each attack); J10 INV OUT (0 to -8 V).

g.desc: Extras: J8 PUSH button (debounced by R17/C5, read by Q5 into Q1's base: a manual gate); J9 TRIG OUT (about 1.5 ms, 0/+10 V, each attack); J10 INV OUT (0 to -8 V).

g.text: 2.2 uF, Q6 follower + 220 R + A1M: attack 0.7 ms-2.8 s, decay/release tau 0.5 ms-2.2 s. Output 0..8 V through 1k; LED follows the envelope.

g.desc: 2.2 uF, Q6 follower + 220 R + A1M: attack 0.7 ms-2.8 s, decay/release tau 0.5 ms-2.2 s. Output 0..8 V through 1k; LED follows the envelope.

g.text: Decay to exactly the sustain voltage (U1A + D2 ideal diode; D3 lifts it during attack, D6/Q7 while the gate is low); release via Q4 switch to ground.

g.desc: Decay to exactly the sustain voltage (U1A + D2 ideal diode; D3 lifts it during attack, D6/Q7 while the gate is low); release via Q4 switch to ground.

g.text: env-adsr: gate -> Q1/Q2 -> edge trigger (Q3) -> timer flip-flop; attack until the capacitor reaches 8 V (2/3 of 12 V)

g.desc: env-adsr: gate -> Q1/Q2 -> edge trigger (Q3) -> timer flip-flop; attack until the capacitor reaches 8 V (2/3 of 12 V)

g.text: LOOP (J11, on-off-on): Q8 (PNP, env vs sustain wiper) and Q10 hold Q9 off until the decay reaches sustain + 0.5 V, then Q9 retriggers the 555; down GATE: while the gate is held; up FREE: free-running (a forced gate via D74/R82/D75).

g.desc: LOOP (J11, on-off-on): Q8 (PNP, env vs sustain wiper) and Q10 hold Q9 off until the decay reaches sustain + 0.5 V, then Q9 retriggers the 555; down GATE: while the gate is held; up FREE: free-running (a forced gate via D74/R82/D75).
